name: Awlrach the Drowner
abilities:
Drifting on Spectral Tides: End of Any Turn Roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can immediately use the 'Normal Move' or the 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase.
Passage Through the Underworlds: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase If this unit is not in combat, pick a friendly non-Hero Nighthaunt unit that is not in combat and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. Remove this unit and the target from the battlefield, then set them up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of each other and more than 7" from all enemy units.

name: Cairn Wraith
abilities: Eager Death-Dealers: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase Pick a visible friendly Grimghast Reapers unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. Add 1 to wound rolls for the target's combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

name: Guardian of Souls
abilities: Nightmare Lantern: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase Pick a visible friendly Nighthaunt unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to wound rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.

name: Knight of Shrouds
abilities:
Stolen Hours: Each time this unit uses a Fight ability, after that Fight ability has been resolved, Heal (X) this unit, where X is the number of damage points allocated to enemy units by combat attacks made as part of that Fight ability.
Infantry Overseer: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit Pick a friendly non-Hero Nighthaunt Infantry unit that has not used a Fight ability this turn and is within this unit's combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a Fight ability immediately after the Fight ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.

name: Knight of Shrouds on Ethereal Steed

weapons.name: Ethereal Steed's Ghostly Hooves and Teeth

abilities:
Stolen Hours: Each time this unit uses a Fight ability, after that Fight ability has been resolved, Heal (X) this unit, where X is the number of damage points allocated to enemy units by combat attacks made as part of that Fight ability.
Cavalry Overseer: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit Pick a friendly non-Hero Nighthaunt Cavalry or War Machine unit that has not used a Fight ability this turn and is within this unit's combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a Fight ability immediately after the Fight ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.

name: Krulghast Cruciator
abilities: Empowered Through Excruciation: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each friendly Nighthaunt unit wholly within 12" of this unit in each phase.

name: Kurdoss Valentian, the Craven King
abilities:
Hail Kurdoss! King of Nothing!: Your Charge Phase If this unit charged this phase, pick a friendly Craventhrone Guard unit that is not in combat to be the target. The target can immediately use a Shoot ability as if it were your shooting phase, but all of its attacks must target an enemy unit in combat with this unit. The target cannot use Charge abilities for the rest of the turn.
If I Cannot Rule, None Shall Rule!: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a unit within 12" of this unit Roll a dice. On a 3+, unless your opponent spends 1 additional command point to use that command, the command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.

name: Lady Olynder, Mortarch of Grief
abilities:
No Rest for the Wicked: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase Pick any number of friendly Nighthaunt units on the battlefield to be the targets. For each target, you can return a number of slain models to that unit with a combined Health characteristic of up to D3+3.
Mortarch of Grief: If the unmodified hit roll or unmodified wound roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.
Grief-stricken: Your Hero Phase Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. Ignore positive modifiers to the target's control score and to hit rolls, wound rolls and save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
Keywords: Spell

name: Lord Executioner
abilities:
Ghastly Descent: End of Any Turn Pick an enemy Infantry or Cavalry Hero that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit's attacks to be the target. Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is a Sentenced unit. On a 5+, the target is automatically destroyed.
Staring Death in the Face: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 2+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn. In addition, if the target is a Hero, subtract 5 from the target's control score for the rest of the turn.

name: Nagash, Supreme Lord of the Undead
abilities:
Battle Damaged: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, subtract 3 from its power level.
The Staff of Power: Add 2 to casting rolls for this unit while it has not miscast any spells this turn. If this unit miscasts a spell, ignore the restriction that would stop this unit from casting any more spells this turn.
Hand of Dust: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn Pick a visible enemy Hero or Monster in combat with this unit to be the target. Hide a dice in one of your hands or under one of two appropriate containers. Your opponent must pick one of your hands or containers. If they pick the one hiding the dice, this ability has no effect. If they pick the empty one, the target is automatically destroyed.
Keywords: Rampage
Supreme Lord of the Undead: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase Pick a friendly non-Hero non-Unique Death unit that has been destroyed to be the target. Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
Invocation of Nagash: Your Hero Phase This unit can cast this spell more than once per phase. Pick a visible unit wholly within 18" of this unit that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. If the target is an enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on it. If the target is a friendly Death unit, pick 1 of the following effects:
• Return a number of slain models to the target unit with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.
• If the target was not set up this turn and is not in combat, it can move up to 3". It cannot move into combat.
Keywords: Spell

name: Reikenor the Grimhailer
abilities:
Corpse Candles: Any Hero Phase Pick either this unit or a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target. If you picked this unit, allocate 1 damage point to this unit and add 1 to casting rolls for this unit for the rest of the turn (ward rolls cannot be made for that damage point). 
If you picked an enemy unit, roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that enemy unit and for the rest of the turn:
• Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.
• Add 1 to this unit's power level.
Grim Justice: Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks made with this unit's Fellreaper if the target is a Priest or a Wizard.
Wraithstorm: Your Hero Phase Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If any models are slain as a result of this ability, inflict a further D3 mortal damage on the target
Keywords: Spell

name: Scriptor Mortis
abilities:
Sentenced to Eternal Torment: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target and the target has the Sentenced keyword until the start of your next turn.
Judge, Jury and Executioner: Each time a friendly Nighthaunt Infantry unit uses a Fight ability, if all of its attacks target the same Sentenced enemy unit, that friendly unit's melee weapons have Crit (Mortal) for that Fight ability.

name: Spirit Torment
abilities: Captured Soul Energy: Each time a friendly Nighthaunt unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

name: Tomb Banshee
abilities:
Cacophony of Sorrow: While there are any friendly Myrmourn Banshees units wholly within 12" of this unit, ignore positive modifiers to the control scores of enemy units within 12" of this unit.
Ghostly Howl: Once Per Battle(Army), Any Shooting Phase Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target. Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If any models in the target unit are slain by this ability, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

name: Black Coach

weapons.name: Relic Bearers' Claws and Ethereal Steeds' Hooves

abilities:
Runaway Coach: Any Charge Phase If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target. Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage equal on the target equal to the roll.
Nimbus of Power: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase If this unit is not in combat, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
Keywords: Core
Evocation of Death: End of Any Turn If any damage points were allocated to an enemy unit by this unit's combat attacks this turn and that enemy unit was destroyed this turn, pick a friendly non-Unique Nighthaunt Hero that has been destroyed. Set up a replacement unit wholly within 12" of this unit. The replacement unit can only be set up in combat with enemy units that are in combat with this unit.

name: Black Coach (Scourge of Aqshy)
abilities:
Spectral Attendants: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase Pick 1 of the following to apply for the rest of the turn:
Noble Blade: This unit's melee weapons, including Companion weapons, have Crit (Mortal) instead of Crit (Auto-wound).
Unholy Grail: Each time a friendly Nighthaunt unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'Rally' command, you receive 3 additional rally points.
Tome of Undead Lore: This unit has Wizard (1).
One Stop, No Return: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase Pick an objective you do not control to be the target. For the rest of the turn, while enemy units are contesting the target objective, attacks made by those units cannot score critical hits while this unit is also contesting it (treat them as regular hits instead).
Spectral Carriage: Your Charge Phase For the rest of the phase, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.

name: Bladegheist Revenants
abilities: Thrashing Desperation: While this unit contests an objective you control, enemy units cannot finish a charge move within 1/2" of a model in this unit unless the unmodified charge roll was 7 or more.

name: Chainghasts
abilities: Another Link in the Chain: Any Combat Phase Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if this unit is wholly within 12" of any friendly Spirit Torments. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly Nighthaunt units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

name: Chainrasps
abilities: Chilling Horde: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase Pick up to 3 friendly Chainrasp units to be the targets, Each target can move 6" but cannot end that move in combat.

name: Craventhrone Guard
abilities: Black-hearted Lackeys: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target. Roll a D3. On a 2+, this unit immediately uses the 'Retreat' ability without any mortal damage being inflicted on it. Then, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

name: Dreadblade Harrows

abilities:
Curse of Loyalty: If this unit charged this turn, add 3 to the control scores of friendly Nighthaunt units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
Phantasmal Discorporation: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

name: Dreadscythe Harridans
abilities: Harrowing Shrieks: Enemy units cannot be healed or have slain models returned to them while they are in combat with this unit.

name: Glaivewraith Stalkers
abilities: Unerring Hunters: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase For the rest of the turn, each time this unit makes a pile-in move, add 3" to the distance it can move.

name: Grimghast Reapers
abilities: Reaped Like Corn: Any Combat Phase Pick an enemy unit that is within the combat ranges of 5 or more models in this unit to be the target. Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If the target unit has 20 or more models, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each 5+ instead.

name: Myrmourn Banshees
abilities: Spell-eaters: Reaction: Opponent declared a Spell ability If a friendly Nighthaunt unit wholly within 12" of this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, this unit can use the 'Unbind' ability as if it had Wizard (1). Add 1 to the unbinding roll for that ability. If the spell is unbound, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster

name: Pyregheists
abilities:
Light a Pyre: Once Per Turn (army), End of Any Turn If this unit is contesting an
objective, pick a visible enemy unit within
6" of this unit to be the target. Roll a D3. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Add a number equal to the roll to this unit's control score for the rest of the turn.

name: Spirit Hosts
abilities: Drawn to War: Friendly Nighthaunt Infantry Heroes have Ward (4+) while they are wholly within this unit's combat range.

name: Spirit Hosts (Scourge of Aqshy)
abilities:
Terrifying Spectres: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the enemy target. Then, you can pick a friendly Nighthaunt Hero in combat with the enemy target to be the friendly target. You can spend 1 rage dice. If you do:
• Apply the effect below.
• If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.
For the rest of the turn:
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by the enemy target that do not target this unit.
• Ignore positive modifiers to hit rolls for the enemy target's attacks.
• If you picked a friendly target, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of its melee weapons for attacks that target the enemy target.

name: Battle Traits: Nighthaunt
abilities:
Ethereal: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for friendly Nighthaunt units, excluding Nagash.
Ethereal Translocation: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase Pick a friendly Nighthaunt unit that is not in combat to use this ability. Remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
Mounting Dread: Subtract the current battle round number from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with any friendly Nighthaunt units.
Sepulchral Apparitions: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase If there is a friendly Nexus of Grief on the battlefield, you can set up up to 2 additional Nexuses of Grief on the battlefield. Each must be set up wholly outside enemy territory, more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features, and more than 12" from all other friendly Nexuses of Grief.
Designer's Note: *The original* Nexus of Grief *is set up in Step 1 of the deployment phase using the 'Deploy Faction Terrain' ability. This ability allows you to set up a second and third such terrain feature and is used in Step 3 of the deployment phase, after armies have been deployed.*

name: Thorns of the Briar Queen
abilities:
Ghostly Howl: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by attacks made with this unit's Piercing Scream to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 2+, the target cannot use commands until the start of your next turn.
The Briar Queen: While this unit's Briar Queen is on the battlefield, it has Wizard (1).

name: The Headsmen's Curse
abilities:
Furious Indictment: Your Hero Phase Pick an enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target is condemned until the start of your next turn.
While a unit is condemned:
• Halve that unit's Move characteristic.
• That unit cannot use Retreat abilities.
• Subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for that unit, to a minimum of 1.

name: Kurdoss Valentian, the Craven King (Scourge of Ghyran)
abilities:

*Regicide and Kinslaying:* The target's melee weapons have Anti‑Hero (+1 Rend).
*Usurpation and Larceny:* Add 5 to the target's control score.
*Sedition and Betrayal:* Enemy units cannot use commands while they
are in combat with the target.
Inescapable Mockery: Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit's combat attacks that target an enemy unit that has a lower Control characteristic than this unit.

name: Nexus of Grief
abilities:
Awful Refashioning: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn Pick a friendly Nexus of Grief, then pick up to 3 friendly Nighthaunt units wholly within 12" of it to be the targets. You cannot pick the same unit to be a target of this ability more than once per phase. For each target:
• If the target is damaged, Heal (D3) the target.
• If the target is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to D3.
Screams of the Penitent: Enemy units cannot use commands while they are within 3" of this terrain feature.
Hungry Crypts: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase Remove this terrain feature from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield within 3" of a friendly Nighthaunt unit, more than 3" from all objectives and enemy units, more than 1" from all terrain features and more than 12" from all other friendly Nexuses of Grief.

name: Lord Vitriolic
abilities:
Spectral Alchemy: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase Pick a visible enemy unit within 10" of this unit to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects or roll two dice and apply both corresponding effects in an order of your choosing, including duplicate effects:
1 *Phantasmal Solvent:* If the target has a Move characteristic of '-', inflict 6 mortal damage on the target.
2 *Acidic Fug:* Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
3 *Fling Concoctions:* Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Hurled Vial this phase but all attacks made by this unit this phase must target that enemy unit.
4 *Choking Vapours:* If the target is a Wizard, subtract 1 from its power level until the start of your next turn.
5 *Fear-laced Hallucinogen:* If the target is a Priest, remove D3 ritual points from it.
6 *Unholy Prescription:* Ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the turn.
